sn5.5:1.2: Regarded as the greates in psychic power ([an1.237:1.1]()), and, with Khemā, the ideal nun ([an2.131:1.2](), [an4.176:2.2]()). She taught other nuns ([thig13.5:27.3]()), and was devoted to the Buddha ([pli-tv-bu-vb-np5:1.1.1]()). Despite her dauntless rejection of Māra here, a story in the Vinaya says she was once raped by a Vedic student who was infatuated with her ([pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:10.5.1]()). The Buddha declared that one who does not consent is innocent.
sn5.5:2.1: These verses are included in Uppalavaṇṇā’s at [thig11.1:7.1]().
